repository.untracked_inputs: covered by the individual body, prompt, design, and source-file hashes below

provider.name: Claude Code
provider.authentication: existing local OAuth session; no credential material retained
provider.unsupported_limits_note: Claude Code 2.1.207 exposes neither max-turns nor an output-token cap; every pair uses the same one-prompt print invocation and a USD budget cap.

source_verification.work: The Principles of Product Development Flow: Second Generation Lean Product Development
source_verification.author: Donald G. Reinertsen
source_verification.locator: chapter 2, cost of delay and weighted shortest-job-first principles

source_verification.author: Richards J. Heuer Jr.
source_verification.edition: CIA Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999

body_boundary.treatment: canonical role body composed with the selected baseline corpus through cli.sync.agent_body; no user expertise overlay exists for either role
body_boundary.control: exact canonical role body emitted by git show from the frozen HEAD before either role had a baseline corpus
body_boundary.surrogate_delta: live comparisons omit generated adapter metadata and shared web-policy text equally; deterministic render and adapter sync checks cover those shared wrappers separately

parity_gate: within each role/case pair, prompt hash, executable, version, cwd, model, effort, budget, tool policy, safe-mode flags, and injection mechanism are identical
only the frozen treatment/control body path and hash differ
all response files must be successful JSON result envelopes with is_error false

stopping_rule.formula: role_pass = parity_all_pairs AND all_four_records_successful AND all_primary_treatment_criteria_true AND all_primary_control_criteria_false AND treatment_counter_true
stopping_rule.content_reruns: forbidden; a completed response is scored as returned
stopping_rule.infrastructure_retry: one retry is allowed only after an authentication, transport, or client-process failure and must rerun all four arms for that role with unchanged frozen inputs
stopping_rule.failed_gate: retain all evidence and keep the five-role release blocked; any new prompt or rubric requires a new versioned envelope

scorer.method: criterion-level boolean scoring with cited response evidence
